batting.name: P Simran Singh
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b K Rabada

batting.name: M Shahrukh Khan
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b Avesh Khan

batting.name: CJ Jordan
batting.dismissal: c Lalit Yadav b K Rabada

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c DJ Malan b RP Meredith

batting.name: RR Pant
batting.dismissal: c MA Agarwal b CJ Jordan

balls.text: 99 not out for Mayank as he can't get the elevation of this straight drive. It was in the slot, similar to the last delivery, and he was low in his set up. Drilled it between non-striker and the stumps
crunched straight to get into the nineties! Overpitched at middle stump and once again he's set up early, stayed low. His back knee is on the floor as he lofts this
low full toss at middle stump. He's stepped deep into the crease and towards off stump as the bowler runs in. That's opened up the leg side and he slugs this between long-on and deep midwicket
slower ball, short and into the ribs as he's missed on the pull. Drops pitch side - the ball, that is - and Mayank calls for the run
length and very wide outside off, left alone. Couldn't sneak the run this time, Pant was ready with a glove off
full and just outside off, clears the front leg and drives firmly, but along the ground to long-off
slower ball, short and wide outside off. Beaten on the cut and Mayank calls through for the run
drilled past the bowler's head! Overpitched outside off, nice driving length. Clears the front foot and closes the face to send this springing into the straight boundary
short and tucked him up at leg stump. He can't get a swing away on the pull, ends up stabbing at it and gets a top edge that floats out to deep square
low full toss at leg stump, toe-ended drive to long-on's left
slower short ball at middle stump, forced to adjust and pull this to long-on's right
thigh height full toss outside off, slog comes off the under-edge towards square leg
yorker at off stump, clears the front leg and jams towards long-off
drilled straight over the bowler! Classy stuff. From the batter. Not so much from Rabada, who bowls a cross-seamer at length on off stump. Clears the front leg and times this lofted drive sweetly
another fantastic yorker, at leg stump and forced to squeeze down to long-on for a single
yorker at off stump, gets low and tries to jam through the off side. Can't get it past the bowler. Brilliant execution this
full and just outside off, driven firmly to extra cover where Hetmyer fumbles to give away a run
yorker outside off, chopped straight to backward point

taken at extra cover by Hetmyer pedaling backwards. It's overpitched but it's fast. Shahrukh wants to hit this straight but is not in position at all, still into his shuffle, as he attempts it. Sliced and not far past the circle
dipping yorker at off stump, jabbed down to long-on
short of a length at leg stump, pulled along the floor to deep square
length at off stump, leans in and punches to long-on
length outside off, punched to extra cover's left
slow at a length on middle stump, steps out for the drive and gets an inside edge onto pad
and another bit of brilliant placement. Short of a length at leg stump, might have looked to pull for six on another pitch. Here he stays low and swipes in front his body to deep midwicket's left
oh nicely placed. Short of a length and into leg stump, gets forward and swipes it between deep square and deep midwicket
full and just outside off, driven along the floor to sweeper

dropped by Lalit diving backwards at point. Very difficult one. Slower ball at a length outside off, looks for the slog sweep and gets a leading edge. Lalit is forced to dive backwards and manages to get two hands on it. Can't grab it
drilled over the wide long-off boundary. Another friendly delivery from Ishant, lobbed up full and just outside off. Gets a nice stride in and crunches this
full offcutter outside off, toe-ended drive to sweeper cover
yorker at off stump, opens the face and chops into the off side

steered to the long leg boundary to bring up a fighting half-century. It's not been a pitch that suits Mayank Agarwal but he's found a way to get deep. This is a full toss on leg stump and he crouches to put it away
full outside off, driven straight to extra cover
pulled over midwicket. Dropped short and just outside off, he's welcomed that with a sigh - a release shot after a long time. Comes on nicely and he pulls clean
full and just outside off, springs into this extra cover drive but can't beat the man to his right. Parried to mid-off
length at off stump, pushed in front of point off the front foot
full and into leg stump, flicked to deep square's right
length and just outside off, steered to third man off the front foot
length and just outside off, stabbed on the rise to extra cover
short of a length outside off, punched firmly to sweeper's left and a confident call to come back for the second
length and just outside off, sticks in the pitch as he pushes at it. To extra cover off the front foot

mix-up and we're going upstairs to see who is out. Looks like a run-out at both ends to me at first. It's a length ball at off stump, Agarwal drives to extra cover's right and takes off. Hooda doesn't want the run. Hetmyer lunges to his right and quickly flicks it back in at the non-striker's end. Hooda and Agarwal are both headed for that end when Axar receives the throw and takes the bails off. The batsmen hadn't crossed on the pitch, because Hooda was always running backwards. And he is short of the crease when Axar completes the run-out. So he's the one who will be dismissed. Mayank arrives in frame later. He's safe. Axar also throws it to the other end, to Pant, for good measure. Hooda would've survived if he had looked to sacrifice his wicket, ironically
length at leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket's left

knocks leg stump. Lovely bowling. Slows it right down, lands it a length on middle and leg. Turns it in marginally and draws an early hoick from Malan. Completes his stroke and there's a delay before the ball hits the leg stump
short of a length and slowed down at middle stump, backs away and punches to sweeper's right
length and wide outside off, leans in and slashes to sweeper's right
low full toss at off stump, clears the front leg and punches this over the boundary, on the bounce to long-off's right
short of a length and into middle stump, makes room and punches to sweeper off the back foot
length at leg stump, swept to deep backward square
low full toss at off stump, backs away and drives to long-off
full and just outside off, driven off the toe-end to long-off
short and up at leg stump, swivels and pats that past short fine with a hook
yorker just outside off, squeezed into the covers
offcutter at a length on off stump, shuffles and pokes towards point
full and just outside off, gets forward and nails this inside-out drive over extra cover. Holds his shape nicely and gets it over the boundary
short of a length and sliding on in the corridor, backs into the leg side for the cut and is beaten
yorker just outside off, jammed into the off side
low full toss at off stump, toe-ended drive to extra cover's left
slower ball, short of a length outside off, shuffles and pulls on the bounce to midwicket
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Mistimed punch straight to extra cover
short and steep at middle stump, miscued pull plops into the square leg region
short of a length at off stump, chopped straight to backward point
short of a length and tight at the stumps, backs away and cuts straight to point
short of a length and turning into middle stump, punched to extra cover off the back foot
short of a length just outside off, punched straight to backward point
short of a length at middle stump, pulled off the front foot to deep midwicket's left
length and just outside off, gets forward and looks to drive on the up. That just doesn't come on. Lands on the bounce in front of extra cover

huge lbw appeal as Malan looks to flick. He's struck right in front. This looks very good to me. Length ball from Axar at off stump, he shuffled and missed on the flick as it turns in. On the knee roll with leg stump visible. Delhi review. There's no bat. It's umpire's call on wickets. That was clipping the outside of leg stump.
full at leg stump, flicked to deep backward square
short of a length and skidding on at the stumps. Backs away and mistimes the punch to extra cover
short and just outside off, punched firmly to sweeper's left
length and pushed through outside off, whipped drive to sweeper cover
short and coming on slowly as he shapes to pull, gets it to long-on's right
short at leg stump, pulled to deep square's right
short and skidding on low at middle stump, pulled along the ground to deep square
length and turning into leg stump, pushed towards deep midwicket
length outside off, gets forward and drives on the up to sweeper's left
length on leg stump, clipped through vacant square leg
length outside off, gets forward and drives to extra cover
short of a length at off stump, punched to long-on off the back foot

scythed past point. Length and pushed through fast again, but with a lot of width. Mayank is always so close to the ground when he gets forward. Nice position to slash this between point and short third
full and just outside off, driven on the bounce to extra cover
short and just outside off, cut to sweeper off the back foot
full and fast at leg stump, 102kph, jammed down to long-on
short outside off, punched to sweeper cover
short of a length at middle stump, pulled to deep midwicket
length and just outside off, opens the face and runs that towards short third
short and just outside off, reaches out and stabs straight to short third who misfields and parries that towards deep point
length at off stump, leans in and opens the face to run that to deep point's left
low full toss at off stump, opens the face and squeezes this to deep backward point's right

stumps flying!This is a 144kph full toss, dipping away from middle stump. Gayle is startled by that and hurriedly pushes at this. In panic, almost. Completely misses that and off stump goes cartwheeling as he hits the top of it. Probably an attempted yorker gone wrong, but full and fast has done it
swiped over square leg! Short at middle stump, quick reaction and quicker hands as he goes across the line of this, on the rise
smack. Complete domination that. Short of a length and wide outside off, presses forward and slaps it between cover and extra. Neither of them moved
full and just outside off, looks to crunch that on the front foot, gets an inside edge onto the foot
bouncer in the corridor, looks to hook and is beaten
hammered past mid-off with a flat bat. Short and rising in the corridor, gets into his forward press and gets this over Mayank
length and just outside off, poked into the covers
short of a length in the corridor, gets forward and clips towards mid-on
short of a length at off stump, dropped into the off side with soft hands
leading edge as he closes the face on this. A full toss at leg stump, ends up in the covers
full and just outside off, backs away and jabs into the covers

jogs to the left and holds on at mid-off. Smith. Full and just outside off stump. Clears the front and looks to drill that wide of the fielder. It ends up a friendly slice and Smith takes it easily, about chest height, with palms facing each other like he's an evil character casting a spell
short of a length and just outside off, cut to deep point
short of a length and in at off stump, dropped into the off side with soft hands
slower ball at a length outside off, looks to slap that straight and gets it off the inside edge
full at off stump, driven straight to cover point
short of a length and rising in the corridor, jags away as he looks to launch this over extra cover on the up
steps out and slaps it over the cover boundary. Nicely put away. Short ball outside off, steps out and meets this with a horizontal bat to send it a long way

dropped at deep point. A tough one for Avesh. Length ball wide outside off, reaches out and chops at that. Might have been a slower ball. It dips on Avesh and is travelling quick and flat. Lunges and gets two hands on it but can't hold on
short of a length in the corridor, punched to deep point
short of a length and into off stump, opens the face and pats to short third's right
length and into leg stump, whipped to deep square's right
short of a length and just outside off, chopped out to deep point
short of a length at leg stump, jabbed to midwicket's right
short of a length and in at off stump, stays deep in the crease and jabs it to cover's left
length and slanted into off stump, defended into the covers
a maiden to start. Legcutter, short of a length outside off and he mistimes the cut into the covers
good length and slanted into middle stump, hurriedly stabbed into the covers
beaten. Short of a length and jumping up outside off as he looks to chop this
short of a length outside off, looks to cut and gets an under-edge to the keeper
length and into middle stump, defended down the pitch off the back foot
length and a bit wobbly at middle stump, gets deep in the crease and jabs into the off side
a wide to finish the game. Full and very wide and he doesn't even bother chasing it this time
full toss wide outside off, chucks his hands at that and is beaten
gorgeous! Full and wide outside off, 142kph, gets down on a knee and holds his shape as he brings out a sweet extra cover drive to the fielder's left
pulled over the midwicket boundary! Short ball at leg stump at 144kph, clears the front leg again and that helps him swivel into this and pull neatly over the infielder
pinged over the bowler! Length ball across off stump, gets the front leg into the leg side for the swinging room and clubs this straight with an angled bat
slower ball at a length on middle stump, swept to deep square
short ball outside off, 143kph. Looks for the pull and cue-ends it towards the bowler. Drops short of Jordan, luckily for him
slower short ball at off stump, pulled to deep square's left
length at off stump, driven on the rise to backward point

bat flies into the leg side, ball into the off side. Pant headed to the dugout. It's a length ball at the stumps, he wants to muscle this over the leg side and loses his shape. Loses his bat too. It floats up for Agarwal at extra cover, an easy slice to catch
length outside off, 143kph, driven on the up to sweeper cover
slower short ball at off stump, steps out and pulls to deep midwicket's left
short and just outside off, cut straight to backward point
short of a length outside off, waits on that and spanks it to sweeper's left
short of a length and sliding low outside off, toe-ended cut to extra cover
length outside off, reverse lap sweep can't beat short third
length outside off, steps out and clips through midwicket
length outside off, slapped on the up to long-off
full slower ball at middle stump, driven to extra cover

whipped over deep square! Full and into the pads. Uses the angle to whip through that, back leg in the air for some flamboyance. Brar was a couple of yards in from the line and couldn't get back in time
length at off stump, gets forward and pushes to point's left
short ball at waist height, angled into the body from around the wicket. Not going to trouble Dhawan like that. Swivels and places this pull to fine leg's right
short outside off, steered to third man
short outside off, cut to sweeper cover
short of a length and sliding on outside off, under-edge on the attempted cut
googly at a length on leg stump, pushed to midwicket off the back foot
starts with a reverse sweep and it is vicious and past slip. Googly at a length outside off, stretches out and gets that between slip and backward point
short of a length outside off, chopped to sweeper's right
smoked again! Slog sweep firmly to deep midwicket's right this time. Full and pushed through quick, gets down low and swings through this
smoked over deep midwicket to bring up another fifty! Whew, what confidence. Full and just outside off, got down so quickly and middled this perectly

chipped straight to deep square. Smith's made a habit of playing surprising shots in the IPL when they aren't required. This is one of them. Length and into off stump. Walks into the off side and wants to whip this behind square on the leg. That sticks slightly in the pitch and he ends up getting too far under it. Lofted right up and Malan takes an easy one
short of a length and into the body, swiped down to fine leg
slower short ball at the thigh, can't get that pull short away, catches it on the body
full and just outside off, 144kph, driven straight to mid-off
length at off stump, punched to sweeper cover on the up
short at middle stump, pulled to deep square

runs diagonally in between the stumps and umpire but is still over the wicket. So his run-up's started behind the non-striker. From there he's run towards his left and managed to bowl a legbreak, somehow. You'd be tearing muscles you didn't know you had if you tried that tomorrow. It is dropped short though, outside off, and he pulls to deep midwicket
short of a length at middle stump, punched through midwicket
googly, short of a length and wide outside off. Cut to sweeper cover
short of a length slider at off stump, punched to extra cover

carted over deep midwicket! Bishnoi slides on nicely and generally takes it across the left-hander. That's made the slog sweep a nice option for Dhawan - swinging room, pace, all of it. Picks this length ball from outside off
length at middle stump, steps out and flicks to deep midwicket
length at leg stump, steps out and expertly flicks this to deep midwicket's right
short of a length at leg stump, punched to deep midwicket
short of a length at middle stump, pulled to deep square
short of a length at off stump, punched to sweeper off the back foot
length outside off, steps out and stabs this with soft hands in front of mid-on
chipped to long-off's left. Length ball turning away from off stump, goes inside-out with the bounce and turn
length at leg stump, leans in and punches to long-on
length at off stump, pushed into the off side with soft hands and a tight run. The throw missed at the non-striker's end and he got away there
length at middle stump, punched to long-on
oh well placed but Bishnoi doesn't let much through, he's having a wonderful life in the outfield this season. Short and wide outside off, cut firmly to sweeper's left but can't beat his slide
short of a length and sliding on at middle stump, backs away and slaps to sweeper
short of a length and sliding into the corridor, cut to point
length and tight at off stump, blocked into the covers
length at middle stump, swept along the floor to deep square
length at leg stump, clipped to deep square's left
length at off stump, deep to punch to long-off
short of a length at off stump, waits on that and punches late to sweeper's right
length and at the stumps, punched to long-off
beaten on the cut. Short of a length slider and he hasn't picked it as he looks to cut. Narrowly past off stump
short of a length legbreak outside off, gets deep in the crease and whips this to long-on's right
oh nicely placed. Length ball, googly sliding in towards leg stump. Smith gets down and uses that angle to lap it fine
full and just outside off, gets forward and pushes through the covers
short of a length and sliding across off stump, chopped off the back foot but SRK lunges to his right to stop
slider at a length outside off, gets forward and flicks to long-on

chipped but safely down to long-off. Brar had walked into the leg side, anticipating at punch towards long-on. It was a short of a length ball at middle stump and stuck in the pitch as he punched off the back foot
length at off stump, defended to extra cover
length at middle stump, gets forward and pushes through vacant midwicket
full outside off, flicked back to the bowler
short of a length outside off, gets deep in the crease and clips this through midwicket

the magician is back and doing his thing! What a delivery. Length ball, drifting in at middle stump, drawing him into the drive and turning it past him to hit the top of off stump. What a life this is - Kohli, Maxwell, AB, Shaw his first four IPL wickets

squeezed through for a finishing touch to the powerplay. Hooda things of the drive and doesn't put it in. Decides to chase from extra cover to his right and is beaten. It was a half-volley and he caressed that off the front foot
slower short ball at leg stump, shoveled to deep square off the back foot
short and just outside off, quick hands again as he scythes this between point and short third

picked up over square leg! What a shot. Pure instinct and reflex. Short of a length, about waist height and really tight with the angle. But he's onto that quickly and manages to hit from underneath it with a short-arm pull
bouncer up at the front shoulder, ducks to let it go
short and tight into the body. Stays upright and stabs that to deep square's left
short of a length and skidding across off stump, toe-ended cut into the covers
length ball skidding onto leg stump, jabbed through midwicket off the back foot
short of a length at middle stump, pulled firmly to deep midwicket's left
short of a length and just outside off, cramped on the punch, thick edge to short third's left
short of a length and skidding on outside off, under-edge on the cut
what a shot! Not easy to hit straight against slow bowling on this pitch. This is length at off stump, he gets to the pitch with half a stride, and goes with the turn over the wide long-off region
ah sweeeet. Full and wide outside off, he gets down on one knee and cracks this through the covers with ease
length outside off, driven to mid-off's left. That was an offcutter, he couldn't get his hands through that
full and into leg stump, looks for the flick and cops it on the pad
short of a length and tight in the corridor. Beats him on the cut as this slants in
slower ball at a length, off stump. Gets forward and pushes into the covers
cracked past point. Short and outside off, Dhawan's been putting those away since he was a teenager. Punched from close the body and it flies off the square
short and into the box. He's looked to pull that, a 141kph delivery slanted into his mid-riff. And he's on the floor immediately
yorker at middle stump, jabbed out to mid-off
slower ball, short of a length at middle stump. Backs away and looks to slap that. Gets it to mid-on off the inside half of the bat
length at middle stump, driven on the rise to mid-on
good length and curving into the pads as he looks to flick
short of a length and tight at off stump, hurriedly defended into the off side
length at off stump, defended off the back foot
short of a length just outside off, once again doesn't come on as he likes, and he ends up punching aerially. But it is well hit anyway, and past extra cover

in the air for a bit, safely to point's left. But Malan makes a mess of it to his right at third man. Length outside off, doesn't come on as he swishes at this away from the body. Thick outside edge. Malan slides and his foot gets ahead of his body as he does that and the ball hits that first, and deflects into the boundary
top edge over the keeper and then the boundary. Short and rising in the corridor, a hurried pull at this and enough pace - 144kph delivery - to take that for six
length and tight in the corridor, wants to punch through the off side but there isn't enough room to get a decent connection on this
short and wide outside off, under-edge on the cut to third man
143kph bouncer at an off stump line, ducks to let it go
length at leg stump, 143kph, half a stride to push this into the leg side with soft hands
length at leg stump, deep in the crease as he clips to deep square
short of a length at off stump, opens the face and runs to third man's left
full inswinger, starts leg stump and curves down. Simran flies to the right and grabs two-handed

outside edge dips on first slip and trickles to his right. Length ball at off stump, Dhawan rooted to the crease and swishing. This stays low, comes off the toe-end at 146kph, but lands safely between keeper and wide slip. Went straight to floor
short and up the ribs at 143kph. Takes the bottom hand off and fends this off the inside edge into his thigh guard
